query:
INSERT INTO access.idp_dcr_policies
               (tenant_id, realm_id, version, enabled, domains, tokens, domain_id, decision_pos)
             SELECT $1, $2,
                    COALESCE((SELECT max(version) FROM access.idp_dcr_policies
                               WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND realm_id = $2), 0) + 1,
                    $3, $4, $5, $6, $7
